description: Deposits ERC-20 or native tokens into an entity's protocol treasury (e.g. seller deposit). For ERC-20, call approve_exchange_token first. In metaTx mode, you can skip the approval by passing transferAuthorizations (built with a sign_receive_with_* tool) to send_meta_transaction. Returns unsigned transaction data.

amount.description: Amount in wei. For ERC-20, approve_exchange_token must be called first, unless relaying in metaTx mode with transferAuthorizations passed to send_meta_transaction. Pass as string.

configId.description: Boson/Fermion Protocol deployment identifier. Format: '<env>-<chainId>-<index>' e.g. 'production-137-0' (Polygon mainnet), 'testing-80002-0' (Amoy testnet). Call get_config_ids to list all valid values for this server.

entityId.description: Numeric ID of the entity to credit. Must match signerAddress's seller account.

executionMode.description: 'direct' = standard on-chain tx (sign locally with your wallet → send_signed_transaction). 'metaTx' = gasless relay via Biconomy (send_meta_transaction). Defaults to 'direct'.

signerAddress.description: Ethereum address that will sign and send this transaction. Must match the wallet that will sign the returned transaction locally.

tokenAddress.description: ERC-20 token to deposit. Use address(0) for native ETH.

name: deposit_funds
